ns2:section.sectionText: TOPIC: Ralph Vaughan Williams This seminar class will study a selection of works by British composer Ralph Vaughan Williams (1872-1958) in the light of historical-cultural concepts that have become associated with his music: these include Englishness, pastoralism, anti-industrialism and (more recently) modernism.
ns2:section.sectionDeptRestriction: Restricted to students in the Music department.
